stories.title: Optan por la bicicleta trabajadores en Polanco

en.title: Workers in Polanco opt for bicycles
en.summary: Workers are using bicycles to commute in groups along a bike path from Metro San Joaquín to Plaza Carso, with the service offered free by the local municipality.

stories.title: Marruecos presenta nuevo modelo migratorio; busca frenar la movilidad irregular

en.title: Morocco presents new migration model; seeks to curb irregular mobility
en.summary: Morocco introduced a new migration model designed to reduce irregular movement of people.

stories.title: Matanzas en penal de Mazatlán, otra cara de la guerra Chapitos-Mayiza; hay 12 muertos en dos días, entre ellos “El Owen”

en.title: Killings in Mazatlán prison, another face of the Chapitos-Mayiza war; 12 dead in two days, including "El Owen"
en.summary: Twelve people were killed in a Mazatlán prison over two days amid gang violence, with authorities identifying governance problems in penitentiary conditions.

en.title: Walmart coupon in October 2026
en.summary: Walmart offers promotional codes including 200 pesos in bonuses, 20% off supermarket brands, 50 pesos on Thursdays, and 50% off on Fresh Tuesday.

en.title: Mercado Libre Coupon in October 2026
en.summary: Mercado Libre is offering discount coupons including 12% off selected items, 20% at Yves Rocher, 10% with Banamex, and up to 24 monthly installments.

stories.title: Huracán Simon ya es categoría 4; alerta en Jalisco y Colima

en.title: Hurricane Simon now Category 4; alerts in Jalisco and Colima
en.summary: Hurricane Simon intensified to Category 4 off Mexico's central Pacific coast and is expected to strengthen further, with heavy to torrential rains forecast for western and southern regions including Guerrero, Michoacán, Colima, Jalisco, and Nayarit.

stories.title: Huracán Isaías toca tierra en Florida; deja 512 mil clientes sin electricidad

en.title: Hurricane Isaías makes landfall in Florida; leaves 512,000 customers without electricity
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías touched down in Florida with maximum winds near 170 kilometers per hour, causing over half a million customers to lose power.

stories.title: Isaías toca tierra como huracán de categoría 2 en las costas de EU

en.title: Isaías makes landfall as Category 2 hurricane on US coasts
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías struck near Destin, Florida with maximum sustained winds of 165 kilometers per hour, according to the National Hurricane Center.

stories.title: Simon, strengthening rapidly, could hit Jalisco or Colima as a major hurricane this weekend

en.title: Simon, strengthening rapidly, could hit Jalisco or Colima as a major hurricane this weekend
en.summary: Hurricane Simon, currently Category 2, is moving north under hurricane warning from Michoacán to Nayarit with expected landfall in Colima or Jalisco as early as Saturday.

stories.title: Confirman dos muertos tras segunda riña en penal de Mazatlán, Sinaloa

en.title: Two dead confirmed after second riot in Mazatlán prison, Sinaloa
en.summary: Two people died in a Friday altercation at El Castillo Penitentiary, marking the second day of rioting at the Sinaloa facility.

stories.title: Huracán Simón deja inundaciones y mar de fondo en Acapulco a pocas horas de tocar tierra

en.title: Hurricane Simón causes flooding and rough seas in Acapulco hours before making landfall
en.summary: Hurricane Simón is bringing flooding and dangerous surf conditions to Acapulco while tracking northward toward Puerto Vallarta.

stories.title: Estados Unidos emite alerta a sus ciudadanos en México por el avance del huracán Simon

en.title: United States issues alert to its citizens in Mexico over Hurricane Simon's advance
en.summary: The U.S. State Department warned citizens in Mexico to take precautions as Hurricane Simon approaches, potentially bringing heavy rain, flooding, and high waves to the Mexican Pacific coast.

stories.title: Hacienda baja el IEPS para gasolinas, mientras el diésel va por su quinta semana con cuota cero

en.title: Treasury lowers IEPS for gasoline, while diesel reaches its fifth week with zero tax
en.summary: Mexico's Treasury reduced the special tax on gasoline for the week of October 10-16, with Magna gasoline taxed at 2.39 pesos per liter and Premium at 1.62 pesos, while diesel maintains zero taxation.

stories.title: De equipo de adolescentes a negocio de 490 millones: cómo los Azcárraga convirtieron al América en un imperio

en.title: From teenage team to 490 million business: how the Azcárragas turned América into an empire
en.summary: Club América has evolved from a sports team into a financial asset, with the Azcárraga family now seeking to monetize its fan base, stadium, and brand value.

stories.title: Antes de Chivas y Omnilife, Jorge Vergara se levantaba a las 4:00 de la mañana para vender carnitas

en.title: Before Chivas and Omnilife, Jorge Vergara woke at 4:00 AM to sell carnitas
en.summary: Jorge Vergara faced financial failure early in his career and sold carnitas in the early morning hours before founding his successful companies Chivas and Omnilife.

stories.title: Videos muestran el potente sismo de magnitud 7.7 que sacudió Panamá y provocó pánico entre la población

en.title: Videos show powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake that shook Panama and caused panic among the population
en.summary: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, triggering evacuations in the capital and generating several aftershocks that kept residents on alert.

stories.title: Los empleos que EU perdió con Yokohama reaparecen en un caso laboral contra México

en.title: Jobs lost in the US with Yokohama reappear in labor case against Mexico
en.summary: Nearly 600 jobs disappeared in Virginia when Yokohama moved production to Saltillo, and this case is now under review in a labor rights file before the USTR.
